summary: Retest PASSED. Unmount regression on Alert screen is fixed by the try/catch around sub?.remove() at /app/frontend/app/alert.tsx:70-74. Full E2E on web preview (390x844) with geolocation mocked to Mriehel, Malta (35.8916, 14.4658 ±10m): (1) Home → tap trigger-alert-btn → alert-screen mounts. (2) Warm GPS fix path fires — console shows '[QuakeGuard] using warm GPS fix → 35.8916 14.4658 ± 10 m'. (3) Tap im-safe-btn → POST to https://safequake.onrender.com/api/status returns HTTP 200 — console shows "[QuakeGuard] I'm Safe → response status: 200". (4) alert-success-toast becomes visible. (5) After ~1.2s auto-nav completes: alert-screen detaches and Home's trigger-alert-btn is visible again (zero page errors, no LocationEventEmitter.removeSubscription TypeError). (6) Dismiss flow (round 2): alert-dismiss-btn returns to Home with 0 POSTs to /api/status, and metrics row (MAGNITUDE / DISTANCE / INTENSITY) is readable throughout. No red-screen LogBox, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: The try/catch guard around sub?.remove() (alert.tsx:70-74) is the minimal correct fix for the expo-location web-shim gap and does not affect native (iOS/Android) behaviour where remove() works.

Optional (not blocking): consider also gating the watchPositionAsync warm-up behind Platform.OS !== 'web' so the web build doesn't spin up an unused subscription — the fetch happens instantly there anyway via the fallback path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression fully closed on web preview. Reproduction steps used: viewport 390x844, geolocation mocked via Playwright BrowserContext.set_geolocation to Mriehel Malta (35.8916, 14.4658, accuracy 10). All four review items verified end-to-end. Note: React Native Web renders two DOM nodes with data-testid="trigger-alert-btn" (one is a hidden scroll clone); when re-testing, prefer locator('[data-testid=trigger-alert-btn]').last or wait_for_selector on state='detached' for alert-screen. External endpoint https://safequake.onrender.com/api/status is live and returned 200 during this iteration.
rca_of_issue: The reported unmount regression is resolved. Original RCA (iteration_2): LocationSubscription.remove() from expo-location's web shim was throwing 'LocationEventEmitter.removeSubscription is not a function' during AlertScreen unmount, producing a LogBox red-screen that swallowed router.replace('/'). Mitigation applied by main agent: wrapped sub?.remove() in a try/catch (alert.tsx:70-74). Verified: 0 page errors, no TypeError in console, alert-screen detaches and Home rerenders within the expected 1.2s window.
